statement: From a fixed IR the generator reproduces a byte-identical .lagrange tree whose manifest, bindings, access policy, and deployment plan are produced through the existing manifest validator, binding contract, and access-policy normalizer as final authority; each handler calls entry yields exactly one policy allowlist binding and one logical-id-to-generated-binding-name mapping in deployment-plan.json, and no deployment contract rule is re-implemented in the generator.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Records are emitted only by calling validateExternalServiceManifest, the deployment-binding contract normalization, and the runtime-access-policy normalizer; a schema literal duplicated into the generator is a defect.
Generated binding names appear only in .lagrange output; no developer-facing surface documents or accepts them as input.
